meta.name: remove-deadcode
meta.description: Remove unused code from this project with ultrawork mode, LSP-verified safety, atomic commits. Triggers: remove dead code, dead code, cleanup, remove unused.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动移除项目中未使用的代码，保证安全并生成原子提交
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果项目积累了大量死代码需要安全清理
copy.tagline_en: Automatically remove unused code with safety and atomic commits
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your project has accumulated dead code that needs safe removal

howto.what: 它会扫描项目里没被引用的代码,用 LSP 逐个确认真是死代码后,交给多个并行子代理分批删除,每批单独提交,最后跑一遍类型检查、测试和构建,并给出删除清单和验证结果。
howto.when: 当你提到「remove dead code」「dead code」「cleanup」等关键词,或要求清理未使用代码时触发。

say.text: 帮我清理这个项目里的死代码
say.note: 会先扫描并用 LSP 验证,再分批删除并逐批提交
把扫描范围缩小到该目录

say.text: 查一下 unusedFunc 这个符号是否还被引用
say.note: 只针对该符号做扫描和验证

howto.what_en: It scans the project for unreferenced code, confirms each candidate with LSP references, then hands removals to parallel agents that edit and commit batch by batch, and finally runs typecheck, tests and build, reporting what was removed.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention “remove dead code”, “dead code”, “cleanup” and similar terms, or ask to remove unused code.

say_en.text: Clean up the dead code in this project
say_en.note: Scans, verifies via LSP, removes in batches, commits each
Narrows the scan to that directory

say_en.text: Check whether the unusedFunc symbol is still referenced
